events.label: start
events.note: cold open on the login screen

events.label: login_view
events.note: DF Docket — Sign in with your firm identity

events.label: login_click
events.note: mocked enterprise SSO — Azure AD/Intapp implied, not real auth

events.label: persona_view
events.note: persona select — the choice reshapes every screen downstream

events.label: persona_hover_partner
events.note: considers Partner

events.label: persona_hover_km
events.note: considers Knowledge Management

events.label: persona_click_associate
events.note: picks Associate — mechanical work, teaches rather than just outputs

events.label: dashboard_view
events.note: dashboard — deal snapshot + spine/next-actions chrome already visible

events.label: dashboard_click_open
events.note: opens the matter — no query typed yet

events.label: a0_view_blocker
events.note: A0 — blocker + ranked precedents already waiting on open

events.label: a0_scroll
events.note: scrolls to the ranked candidate list

events.label: a0_thumbsup_kindercare
events.note: thumbs-up on the #1 ranked candidate (KinderCare) — feeds the match-quality signal back

events.label: a0_expand_why
events.note: expands why KinderCare was suggested — industry, size, anchor prototype

events.label: a0_click_search_bank
events.note: elects to search the full bank manually instead of accepting the auto-match immediately

events.label: a2a_view
events.note: A2a — flexible precedent search: facets + natural language, same scorer as A0

events.label: a2a_type_query
events.note: describes the deal in plain language rather than picking filters — literally the app's own placeholder example

events.label: a2a_search_click
events.note: runs the NL search

events.label: a2a_results
events.note: the full 15-deal bank narrows down, KinderCare on top

events.label: a2a_top_result_check
events.note:
top result card text starts: KinderCare
KinderCare — Childcare / earl

events.label: a2a_investigate_click
events.note: investigates the top-ranked candidate

events.label: a2_view_entity
events.note: A2 — entity detail (KUEHG Corp., Barclays, lender group, revolver upsize) confirms this is a real, richly-documented deal

events.label: a2_thumbsup_why
events.note: confirms the match reasoning is sound

events.label: a2_read_credibility
events.note: reads the credibility note — this grid-population step was already proven on this exact deal

events.label: a2_click_populate_grid
events.note: hands off from confirmed candidate to grid population

events.label: b1_view_grid
events.note: B1 — grid auto-populates with per-term grounding + review signals, never one blended score

events.label: b1_scroll_1
events.note: scans past the high-confidence, already-confirmed terms

events.label: b1_read_leverage
events.note: reads the springing covenant term — grounded in source, still unreviewed

events.label: b1_confirm_leverage
events.note: confirms it — fast, glanceable, no correction needed

events.label: b1_read_coc
events.note: reads the Change of Control term — inferred, not grounded, still needs a human check

events.label: b1_correct_coc_open
events.note: flags it for correction instead of a blind confirm

events.label: b1_correct_coc_edit_value
events.note: refines the value with the citation, not just accepting the inferred text as-is

events.label: b1_correct_coc_type
events.note: the reasoning is what makes this reusable teaching material later, not just a fixed value

events.label: b1_correct_coc_save
events.note: saves the correction — this is the live moment that will resurface at the close

events.label: b1_scroll_2
events.note: scrolls to the undefined-term rows

events.label: b1_click_undefined_gap
events.note: opens the Auto Cure gap — the system declines to guess

events.label: b2_view
events.note: B2 — states plainly that K&E has never defined this term; routes to Knowledge Management instead of guessing

events.label: b2_read_routed
events.note: the routed Next Action is visible, addressed to the right owner

events.label: b2_click_back
events.note: returns to the grid rather than leaving the flag stranded

events.label: presenter_longpress_start
events.note: long-presses the presenter dot to open the full jump list

events.label: presenter_click_f1
events.note: jumps to the closing moment — correction becomes a teaching artifact

events.label: f1_view
events.note: F1 — 'Worked examples for you': the loop closes

events.label: f1_scroll
events.note: scrolls through the corrections on record

events.label: f1_read_prior
events.note: the prior, seeded correction on a different deal — same term, same reasoning pattern

events.label: f1_read_new
events.note: the correction made moments ago on B1, already sitting alongside it — the corpus just grew, live

events.label: end
events.note: tip-to-tail run complete
